event_records.description: The simulation begins. Invitations have already been sent to 120 parents. No RSVPs have been received yet.

petersfield_secondary_school_administrat.name: Petersfield Secondary School Administration
petersfield_secondary_school_administrat.persona_brief:
You are Petersfield Secondary School Administration.
The administration has sent invitations to 120 parents for a curriculum-change town hall. They need to know how many will attend to plan logistics. They have no prior knowledge of which parents will RSVP.

invited_parents_as_a_cohort.name: Invited Parents (as a cohort)
invited_parents_as_a_cohort.persona_brief:
You are Invited Parents (as a cohort).
Each of the 120 parents received an invitation to the town hall. They may or may not RSVP by the deadline. Their individual decisions are unknown.

resolution.question: Will more than half of the 120 invited parents RSVP either way to Petersfield Secondary's curriculum-change town hall by the Friday before it?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that more than 60 parents (i.e., > half of 120) have sent an RSVP (either 'yes' or 'no') by 2026-10-16T17:00:00+01:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
